geography.parcel_id_format: Variable — two formats coexist: numeric urban (e.g. 035087  00049) and alphanumeric suburban (e.g. D0223E A00020). Both include an internal space. The ArcGIS CurrentParcels service PARCELID field uses these exact strings including spacing.
geography.parcel_id_normalization: preserve-exact — do not strip or pad. The Register GIS and the ArcGIS CurrentParcels service both require the exact string with original spacing.
geography.address_format_notes: Memphis metro addresses follow standard US format. Situs addresses in the ArcGIS layer are in PAR_ADDR1 (full street address string). Owner mailing addresses can be anywhere in the US — look at OWN_STATE to determine absentee status.

register_shelby.official_entity: Shelby County Register of Deeds (Willie F. Brooks Jr.)
register_shelby.portal_type: Land records document search — deed, lien, mortgage recordings from 1820s to present
register_shelby.blocker: Portal is a JavaScript SPA (search.register.shelby.tn.us). Direct HTTP fetch returns only navigation markup without the search form or results. Playwright required to render the SPA and interact with the search form. No public REST API documented.
register_shelby.tn_foreclosure_note: Tennessee is a non-judicial foreclosure state. The Notice of Trustee Sale is published in a newspaper (Daily News) and NOT recorded with the Register of Deeds. The 'Appointment of Successor Trustee' (ASOT) IS recorded — it is the pre-foreclosure action that triggers the newspaper notice. ASOT = strong distress signal. Substitute Trustee's Deed = post-sale (property transferred). Lis Pendens = judicial foreclosure action (less common in TN).
register_shelby.paused_reason: SPA portal requires Playwright build before activation. Enable after Playwright scraper is tested and validated.
register_shelby.verification_note: Register of Deeds portal confirmed at search.register.shelby.tn.us. Free public access — no login, no payment. Filing guidelines confirm Appointment of Successor Trustee and Substitute Trustees Deed as document types. Key document types for TN non-judicial foreclosure: ASOT (pre-sale signal) and Substitute Trustees Deed (post-sale confirmation). Lis Pendens filed in Chancery Court per sample form found at shelbycountytn.gov. The GIS Register portal (gis.register.shelby.tn.us) confirms records are linked by parcelid. Instrument number URL pattern: search.register.shelby.tn.us/search/?instnum=XXXXXXXX.
known_limitations: SPA portal — requires Playwright to render and interact with search form
No public REST API documented for document search
TN Notice of Trustee Sale NOT recorded here — published in Daily News instead
Document type code list requires portal fingerprinting in Playwright Build Mode
Register GIS notes property data from April 2019 certified tax roll for the map view
